LESSON: READING 3.2.1 FLUENCY

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade three
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Etiquette Suggested vocabulary good manners, thank you, sorry, excuse me, sorry,
Topic 3.2: Reading 3.2.1 Fluency
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 3.2.1 Fluency, part of Etiquette Suggested vocabulary good manners, thank you, sorry, excuse me, sorry, in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade three ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: Why is reading without hesitation important?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

1. Read this lesson on Reading 3.2.1 Fluency together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Learning to learn: The learner’s ability to develop relationships is enhanced as they engage in timed reading with peers and give

positive feedback.

Values:
Unity: Cooperation is improved as the learner works collaboratively with peers to read a text while paying attention to
